# Nanexa tecknar jätteavtal – vinsterna räddar börsuppgången

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode is about how resilient the stock market has been despite a US 10-year yield of 5.16%, Brent near $105 and repeated false hopes that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen. The guests credit strong earnings growth and the AI data-centre theme for holding the market up. The main company story is Nanexa's roughly SEK 13bn licence deal with Novo Nordisk, which sent the stock up 116-153%. The episode also covers a busy but selective IPO week, analyst rating changes on Sinch, Salix and Tele2, and guest Carl Hedberg's views on Nibe, Skanska and Avanza/Nordnet.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest Carl Hedberg (DNB Carnegie) believes Nibe's strong run can continue as a hedge against high energy prices.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: dealer overstocking has normalised. Higher oil and gas prices lead to higher European electricity prices, which makes heat-pump investments easier to justify and drives demand. He presents Nibe as a portfolio counterweight to the negative effects of high energy prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil/gas prices fall sharply after a Hormuz reopening
- if consumer willingness to invest weakens
- if dealer inventories build up again

> *"Där tror jag Nibe är ett sådant case. Att högre oljepriser, högre gaspriser kommer leda till högre elpriser i Europa och det är en tydlig drivare för deras efterfrågan."*

---

### 🟢 SKA-B — Skanska | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Carl sees Skanska as a picks-and-shovels play on continued data-centre investment without exposure to whether AI is profitable.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: the data-centre share of Skanska's business, especially in the US, will keep growing. AI data-centre capex is fairly certain over the next few years, so builders face less uncertainty than the AI companies themselves.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler data-centre capex is cut
- if data-centre growth stays a small share of the business

> *"Så jag tycker Skanska är ett bra exempel på om man vill ta rygg på den här fortsatta datacentertrenden, men kanske inte ha så stor exponering mot osäkerheten i om det är lönsamt eller inte."*

---

### 🟢 AZA — Avanza | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Carl finds the AI-disruption fears weighing on Swedish niche banks far-fetched and says it is tempting to go against them.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: the weakness is flow-driven and comes from worries about US banks rather than Avanza's own business model. A contrarian opportunity, but the wording is tentative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demonstrably erodes the brokerage business model
- if flow-driven selling persists

> *"Jag kan tycka att det känns lite långsökt att det skulle påverka deras affärsmodell i någon större omfattning. Så det är lockande att gå lite emot de här..."*

---

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Same contrarian view as Avanza: the AI-disruption worry around niche banks looks far-fetched to Carl.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: pressure on Nordnet reflects contagion from US bank AI fears and fund flows, not fundamentals. Tentatively attractive to go against the move.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demonstrably erodes the brokerage business model
- if flow-driven selling persists

> *"Det har ju tyngt även de här svenska nischbankerna. Jag kan tycka att det känns lite långsökt att det skulle påverka deras affärsmodell i någon större omfattning."*

---

### 🟡 SINCH — Sinch | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: DNB Carnegie cut Sinch to hold; the stock fell ~4.5-5%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (DNB Carnegie), not host opinion. The downgrade comes after a run-up on the AI theme and the positive reception of Meta's Muse AI solution. Carl notes Sinch has been an AI winner.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI theme momentum fades
- if further downgrades follow

> *"Och så ser vi att Sinch backar närmare 5 procent. De har fått en sänkt rekommendation från DNB Carnegie till behåll."*

---

### 🟢 SALIX — Salix Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: DNB Carnegie initiated coverage with a buy; stock up 7-9%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view only (DNB Carnegie initiation at buy). The hosts did not discuss it further. The ticker is inferred, not stated in the episode.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock's reaction to the initiation fades
- if DNB Carnegie revises its rating

> *"medan Salix är upp 9 procent efter att DNB Carnegie satt köp på den aktien"*

---

### 🟠 TEL2-B — Tele2 | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited analyst view: Bernstein lowered its recommendation; the stock rose less than the market.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst downgrade (Bernstein). The new rating level was not stated, so this is only a weak cautionary watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow

> *"Tele2 upp mindre än börsen i stort. Där har Bernstein sänkt sin rekommendation rekommendation för telekombolaget"*

---

### 🟠 CAST — Castellum | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cutting costs and simplifying its organisation; Carl says property companies again face clear headwind from rising rates.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: rising long-term rates have quickly turned into headwind for the property sector. Carl calls the cost cuts natural to defend earnings, but the macro backdrop is negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if long-term rates keep rising toward 6% US 10-year
- if cost savings fail to protect earnings

> *"Ja, det är återigen en ganska tuff period för fastighetsbolagen när räntorna stiger så pass kraftigt."*

---

### 🟠 NANEXA — Nanexa | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Transformative Novo licence (~SEK 13bn; ~EUR 600m upfront plus near-term milestones); now financially stable; new partnership areas expected within ~6 months.

#### Reasoning

Opinion comes from the chairman, an insider, not an independent analyst. The deal removes financing risk, enables a 3-5 year plan and a broader pipeline (Moderna collaboration, new therapy areas). The stock already rose 116-153% on the day, so much is priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Novo milestones are delayed or the deal is terminated
- if no new partnership areas are announced within ~6 months
- if the upfront payment disappoints in quarterly reports

> *"Man talar ofta om transformativt. Det är det för det här bolaget, det är ingen som helst tvekan om det."*

---

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Former Novo chairman Göran Ando acknowledges its challenges but says Novo is very strong financially and the new CEO will succeed over time.

#### Reasoning

Guest view (Ando, former Novo chairman, so possibly biased). A strong majority owner allows long-term thinking. The new CEO is shifting Novo to be more patient- and consumer-centric; the turnaround will take time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new strategy fails to show progress
- if competitive pressure in obesity intensifies

> *"Det kommer att ta lite tid för en stor atlantångare som det är att komma dit, men att de kommer... kommer att lyckas, det har jag ingen som helst tvekan om."*

---
